name: charts
title: Charts
purpose: Compose accessible, theme-aware Unovis charts through a finite facade or Balsa's lower-level chart primitives.
accessibility: The visual plot is supplementary to a complete semantic table.
Graphical boundaries reach 3:1 and chart text reaches 4.5:1 against the owning surface.
Series differ through marker, dash, order, or grouping as well as color.
Motion follows theme tokens and reduced-motion preference.
sizes: responsive positive-size container with optional width and height
commonMistakes: Using feedback roles without explicit meaning.
Rendering Unovis into a zero-size container.

examples.title: Bar comparison
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Charts from "@/components/ui/Charts.vue";
const labels = ["Alpha placeholder", "Beta placeholder", "Gamma placeholder", "Delta placeholder"];
const colors = ["primary", "secondary"] as const;
const series = [
  { label: "Primary series placeholder", data: [18, 32, 24, 41] },
  { label: "Secondary series placeholder", data: [12, 22, 30, 28] },
];
</script>

<template>
  <Charts title="Metrics placeholder" type="bar" bar-mode="grouped" :labels="labels" :series="series" :colors="colors" :height="320" />
</template>
